pairs: A Psalm of David according to an ecstasy.
Be for me a protector God
so as to accomplish my salvation.
quoniam fortitudo mea et refugium meum es tu;
For you are my strength and my refuge;
et propter nomen tuum deduces me et enutries me.
and for the sake of your name, you will lead me and nourish me.
Educes me de laqueo hoc quem absconderunt mihi,
You will lead me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me.
In manus tuas commendo spiritum meum;
Into your hands, I commend my spirit.
You have hated those who practice emptiness to no purpose.
But I have hoped in the Lord.
For you have looked upon my humility;
you have saved my soul from needfulness.
Nec conclusisti me in manibus inimici:
And you have not enclosed me in the hands of the enemy.
statuisti in loco spatioso pedes meos.
You have set my feet in a spacious place.
conturbatus est in ira oculus meus,
My eye has been disturbed by wrath,
Quoniam defecit in dolore vita mea,
For my life has fallen into sorrow,
Infirmata est in paupertate virtus mea,
My virtue has been weakened in poverty,
and my bones have been disturbed.
Super omnes inimicos meos factus sum opprobrium,
I have become a disgrace among all my enemies,
and even more so to my neighbors,
and a dread to my acquaintances.
qui videbant me foras fugerunt a me.
Those who catch sight of me, flee away from me.
like one dead to the heart.
I have become like a damaged utensil.
quoniam audivi vituperationem multorum commorantium in circuitu.
For I have heard the harsh criticism of many who linger in the area.
In eo dum convenirent simul adversum me,
While assembled together against me in that place,
they deliberated on how to take away my life.
But I have hoped in you,
My fate is in your hands.
eripe me de manu inimicorum meorum,
Rescue me from the hand of my enemies
and from those who are persecuting me.
Illustra faciem tuam super servum tuum;
Shine your face upon your servant.
salvum me fac in misericordia tua.
Do not let me be confounded,
for I have called upon you.
and be drawn down into Hell.
those that speak iniquity against the just,
How great is the multitude of your sweetness,
which you keep hidden for those who fear you,
perfecisti eis qui sperant in te in conspectu filiorum hominum!
which you have perfected for those who hope in you, in the sight of the sons of men.
Abscondes eos in abscondito faciei tuæ a conturbatione hominum;
You hide them in the concealment of your face, from the disturbance of men.
You protect them in your tabernacle,
quoniam mirificavit misericordiam suam mihi in civitate munita.
For he has shown his wonderful mercy to me, in a fortified city.
Ego autem dixi in excessu mentis meæ:
But I said in the excess of my mind:
Projectus sum a facie oculorum tuorum:
“I have been cast away from the glance of your eyes.”
And so, you heeded the voice of my prayer,
while I was still crying out to you.
For the Lord will require truth,
and he will abundantly repay those who act with arrogance.
and let your heart be strengthened,
all you who hope in the Lord.
